section.heading: Delegation of Director’s functions or powers

content.p: The Director of Human Biosecurity may, in writing, delegate any or all of the Director’s functions or powers under this Act to an SES employee, or an acting SES employee, in the Health Department.
Note 1: The expressions SES employee and acting SES employee are defined in section 2B of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901.
Note 2: See also sections 34AA to 34A of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901, which contain extra rules about delegations.

The functions or powers that may be delegated under subsection (1) include functions or powers the Director of Human Biosecurity has as an authorised applicant or authorised person for the purposes of a provision of the Regulatory Powers Act because of this Act.
However, the Director of Human Biosecurity must not delegate the Director’s functions or powers under any of the following provisions:
section 113 (human health response zones);
section 570 (issuing identity cards);
section 618 (declared movements).

Also, the Director of Human Biosecurity may delegate a function or power under Part 3 of Chapter 2 (human biosecurity control orders) only to an SES employee, or an acting SES employee, in the Health Department who is a human biosecurity officer.

A human biosecurity officer cannot, under a delegation to which subsection (4) applies, perform a function or exercise a power under section 72 in relation to a human biosecurity control order if the human biosecurity officer:
imposed the order under paragraph 60(1)(b); or
made the request under subsection 71(3) in relation to the order.
In performing any functions or exercising any powers under a delegation made under subsection (1), the delegate must comply with any directions of the Director of Human Biosecurity.

hcontainer.name: part
hcontainer.heading: Provisions relating to the amendment of the Biosecurity Act 2015

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer

content.p: If, before the transition time, a thing was done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer, in the capacity of the Director of Human Biosecurity, for the purposes of:
the old Biosecurity Act; or
a legislative instrument made under the old Biosecurity Act;
then the thing has effect, at and after the transition time, as if it had been done by, or in relation to, the Health Secretary in the capacity of the Director of Human Biosecurity.
Subitem (1) does not apply in relation to a determination made under subsection 42(1) of the old Biosecurity Act.

The transitional rules may provide that subitem (1) does not apply in relation to a specified thing done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer, in the capacity of the Director of Human Biosecurity.

An identity card issued to a chief human biosecurity officer or a human biosecurity officer under subsection 570(1) of the old Biosecurity Act before the transition time is taken, after that time, to have been issued under that subsection of the new Biosecurity Act.

If, immediately before the transition time, a form was approved by the Health Secretary for the purposes of paragraph 570(2)(a) of the old Biosecurity Act, the form is taken, at and after the transition time, to be approved by the Health Secretary, in the capacity of the Director of Human Biosecurity, for the purposes of that paragraph of the new Biosecurity Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Saving of listed human disease determinations

content.p: This item applies if a determination made under subsection 42(1) of the old Biosecurity Act is in force immediately before the transition time.
The determination has effect, at and after the transition time, as if it had been made by the Director-General of the CDC in accordance with section 42 of the new Biosecurity Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Transitional—transfer of documents to Health Secretary

content.p: This item applies to any records or documents that:
(a) relate to a function or power of the Director of Human Biosecurity under the Biosecurity Act 2015 (other than section 42 or 169 of that Act); and
immediately before the transition time, were in the possession of:
the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer; or
an APS employee in the Health Department; or
a delegate of the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer.
The records and documents are to be transferred to the Health Secretary after the transition time.
Note: Any records and documents transferred are Commonwealth records for the purposes of the Archives Act 1983.
The transitional rules may provide that:
subitem (2) does not apply to specified records or documents; or
subitem (2) does not apply to records or documents that relate to a specified function or power of the Director of Human Biosecurity.
(4) Subitem (3) does not limit subsection 33(3A) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901.

Despite the repeal and substitution of section 544A of the Biosecurity Act 2015 a delegation under that section that was in force immediately before the transition time continues in force after that time as if it were made under section 544A of the new Biosecurity Act.

hcontainer.heading: Provisions relating to the amendment of the National Health Security Act 2007

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Health Secretary

content.p: If, before the transition time, a thing was done by, or in relation to, the Health Secretary for the purposes of:
the old NHS Act; or
a legislative instrument made under the old NHS Act;
then the thing has effect, at and after the transition time, as if it had been done by, or in relation to, the Director-General of the CDC.
The transitional rules may provide that subitem (1) does not apply in relation to a specified thing done by, or in relation to, the Health Secretary.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: References to the Health Secretary in instruments

content.p: This item applies to an instrument if:
the instrument was made under the old NHS Act; and
the instrument was in force immediately before the transition time; and
the instrument contains a reference to the Health Secretary.
The instrument has effect, at and after the transition time, as if a reference in the instrument to the Health Secretary were a reference to the Director-General of the CDC.
The transitional rules may provide that subitem (2) does not apply in relation to a specified instrument or a specified reference.
This item does not prevent the instrument from being amended or repealed after the commencement of this item.
In this item:
instrument includes:
a contract, deed, undertaking, arrangement or agreement; and
a notice, authority, order or instruction; and
an instrument made under the old NHS Act or regulations made under the old NHS Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Legal proceedings involving the Health Secretary

content.p: If, immediately before the transition time, the Health Secretary was a party to proceedings relating to the old NHS Act that were pending in any court or tribunal, the Director-General of the CDC is substituted for the Secretary as a party to the proceedings at and after that time.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Temporary additions to the National Notifiable Disease List

content.p: If, immediately before the transition time:
a variation of the National Notifiable Disease List was in force under subsection 12(1) of the old NHS Act; and
the variation was made by the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer;
then the variation has effect, at and after the transition time, as if it had been made by the Director-General of the CDC.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer

content.p: If, before the transition time, a thing was done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer for the purposes of:
the old NORDR Act; or
a legislative instrument made under the old NORDR Act;
then the thing has effect, at and after the transition time, as if it had been done by, or in relation to, the Director-General of the CDC.
The transitional rules may provide that subitem (1) does not apply in relation to a specified thing done by, or in relation to, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: References to the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer in instruments

content.p: This item applies to an instrument if:
the instrument was made under the old NORDR Act; and
the instrument was in force immediately before the transition time; and
the instrument contains a reference to the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer.
The instrument has effect, at and after the transition time, as if a reference in the instrument to the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer were a reference to the Director-General of the CDC.
The transitional rules may provide that subitem (2) does not apply in relation to a specified instrument or a specified reference.
This item does not prevent the instrument from being amended or repealed after the commencement of this item.
In this item:
instrument includes:
a contract, deed, undertaking, arrangement or agreement; and
a notice, authority, order or instruction; and
an instrument made under the old NORDR Act or rules made under the old NORDR Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Legal proceedings involving the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer or Health Secretary

content.p: If, immediately before the transition time, the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer was a party to proceedings relating to the old NORDR Act that were pending in any court or tribunal, the Director-General of the CDC is substituted for the Commonwealth Chief Medical Officer as a party to the proceedings at and after that time.

If, immediately before the transition time, the Health Secretary was a party to proceedings relating to the old NORDR Act that were pending in any court or tribunal, the Director-General of the CDC is substituted for the Health Secretary as a party to the proceedings at and after that time.
